title: Successor-field run at each intermediate time
statement: Let $m,n$ be natural numbers, let $x$ be a finite Boolean input, let $src,dst$ be distinct work-tape indices, let $copy$ be a Boolean, and let $d$ be a configuration of the successor-field machine. Let $s$ be absent or a state index less than $n$. Suppose $d$ is in the tag state and the source tape, starting at its head position, contains the optional-state encoding of $s$. For every time $t$ no greater than the encoding length, the configuration after $t$ steps is $d$ if $t=0$. Otherwise it is the configuration obtained after the tag transition, with the prefix of length $t-1$ of the unary state encoding copied to the destination tape exactly when copying is enabled, and with state unary when $t$ is strictly less than the encoding length and done (carrying whether $s$ is present) otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: $d$ is a configuration of the successor-field machine

the source tape contains the optional-state encoding of $s$ from its head position
